domain.note: sim or real. Every real slot is not requested.

final_error.note: Error at the end of the move, rad × 1000 (signed as the producer wrote it).

joint.note: Rack joint in the CAD export (revolute_2, 3, 6, 8).

mode.note: Control mode: ff_fb = feed-forward plus feedback, ff = feed-forward only.

note.note: The manifest's note for the slot (why a real run is missing).

peak_torque.note: Peak absolute joint torque in the sim. Sim values are tiny because the CAD armature is a 1e-05 placeholder.

rms_error.note: RMS of (target - achieved) joint angle over the run, rad × 1000. Drawn estimate: a simulation. Empty with a reason where no run exists.

situation.note: sim_ff_fb / sim_ff / real_ff_fb / real_ff: domain and control mode.

speed.note: Target speed: slow 4 s per leg, medium 2 s, fast 1 s (manifest config).

speed_order.note: 0 slow, 1 medium, 2 fast: sorts the speed sweep.

status.note: ok, or not requested for a real slot.
